lede: The biggest thing happening in local government this week is the San Miguel County Board of Commissioners taking up four Land Use Code amendments that would add an entirely new Natural Resources article to county code — with separate public hearings on forestry, oil and gas, and deep geothermal operations — and that's worth your time if you care about how this county manages what's under and around us. Town of Telluride's Planning and Zoning Commission also finally hears the Shandoka Lot Redevelopment PUD application for Town-owned land at 860 Black Bear Rd, after a month's delay. Layered on top of all that, the Telluride Hospital District board takes up a possible Two Site Model for care delivery, and the Gondola Advisory Committee gets a federal funding update on the FTA Capital Investment Program.
